name: EMA
description: Exponential Moving Average - trend-following indicator giving more weight to recent prices. Faster than SMA at detecting trend changes.

fields.label: Symbol
fields.description: The ticker symbol for the asset being analyzed (e.g. AAPL, BTCUSDT).

fields.label: Timeframe
fields.description: The timeframe/interval of the candle data (e.g. 1m, 5m, 1h, 1d).

fields.label: EMA Window
fields.description: Number of periods for EMA calculation. For volatile stocks, use longer periods.
